title: AIR Plugins Index
description: Index of agent plugins available in this AIR configuration. A plugin is a named grouping of AIR primitives (skills, MCP servers, hooks) — a compositional unit for bundling and distributing related capabilities. Plugins do not define new artifacts inline; they reference existing artifacts by ID from the corresponding index files.

propertyNames.description: Plugin identifier key. Must be alphanumeric with hyphens or underscores.

Plugin.description: A plugin — a named grouping of AIR primitives (skills, MCP servers, hooks) for bundling and distribution. The body lives in a .plugin/plugin.json manifest referenced by `path`; the index entry carries description, path, and default_in_roots, plus any manifest field it wants to override inline. All referenced artifacts must be defined in their respective index files.

title.description: Belongs in the `.plugin/plugin.json` manifest referenced by `path`. Declaring it here overrides the manifest's value for this field and therefore requires a sibling `path`: an entry with no `path` may not declare it, because inline plugin bodies were deprecated in v0.13.0 and removed (https://github.com/pulsemcp/air/issues/157). Human-readable display name for the plugin.

description.description: Concise description of what this plugin provides.

version.description: Belongs in the `.plugin/plugin.json` manifest referenced by `path`. Declaring it here overrides the manifest's value for this field and therefore requires a sibling `path`: an entry with no `path` may not declare it, because inline plugin bodies were deprecated in v0.13.0 and removed (https://github.com/pulsemcp/air/issues/157). Semantic version of the plugin (e.g., '1.0.0').

path.description: Path to the plugin directory containing a .plugin/plugin.json manifest. Either a relative path within the same catalog, or a remote URI handled by an installed catalog provider (e.g. github://owner/repo[@ref]/path). The manifest supplies the plugin's bundled artifact references (skills, mcp_servers, hooks, plugins) and distribution metadata (author, version, homepage, repository, license, logo, keywords, title), so the index entry stays a lightweight registry of name + description + path (+ default_in_roots). Any of those fields may still be declared inline on this entry to override the manifest field by field, but only alongside this `path` — declaring a plugin's body inline with no `path` was deprecated in v0.13.0 and is no longer accepted (https://github.com/pulsemcp/air/issues/157).

plugins.description: Belongs in the `.plugin/plugin.json` manifest referenced by `path`. Declaring it here overrides the manifest's value for this field and therefore requires a sibling `path`: an entry with no `path` may not declare it, because inline plugin bodies were deprecated in v0.13.0 and removed (https://github.com/pulsemcp/air/issues/157). IDs of other plugins to compose into this plugin. Referenced plugins' primitives (skills, mcp_servers, hooks) are recursively expanded and merged with this plugin's direct declarations. Circular references are rejected at resolution time.

default_in_roots.description: Names of roots this plugin is activated in by default. Use the literal "*" to activate it in every resolved root. This replaces the legacy default_plugins array that lived on root entries — membership is now declared on the artifact.
